sources.core_claim: Quantpedia's rule: rank six Russell style ETFs by 12-month price momentum monthly, long the winner/short the loser, one-month hold. Backtest 1972-2005: 9.25%/yr, Sharpe 0.33, vol ~16.0%, MDD -52.5%.
sources.project_applicability: Grounds the FACTOR menu's cross-sectional-momentum-across-style-ETFs mechanism; this batch tests the mechanism fresh via rotation_cell, not this source's own 1972-2005 long-short number.
sources.reflection: Rule and parameters are rotation_cell's own already-live, unedited mechanism, not fit to this batch's return data; the only new degree of freedom is the menu (ticker list), and the lookback/top_n/rebalance grid is a small preregistered bounded sweep (24 combinations total, within the 24-candidate lightweight-exemption budget), not tuned to any window's outcome.
